row:
Founded in 1996, Stanbridge University offers specialized degrees at the Master, Bachelor, and Associate levels in the fields of Nursing and Allied Health. With locations across Southern California, campuses are located in Orange County, Los Angeles County, Riverside County, and San Diego County.

The Stanbridge University YouTube channel will be highlighting student life at and after Stanbridge.
